text:
Rickard Rakell made the news this week without playing a shift. Several outlets, including Yahoo Sports and WPXI, reported that his no-trade list blocked a deal that would have sent him from Pittsburgh to Chicago. So he stays a Penguin, on a team whose veterans are all hearing their names in trade talk.

The hockey has been good. He has 8 goals and 13 points in 21 games at 19.8 minutes, and 7 of those goals came in his last ten games. This is not luck in disguise: his expected goals (the quality of his shots) come to 8.7, nearly matching the 8 he has scored, and his 14.5% shooting sits inside our range for him. He shoots a lot and from good spots, and our wins added, which credits goals at the moments they swing games, ranks him 34th of 548 skaters.

The weak spot is assists, only 5, which holds his scoring rate below his norm, and Pittsburgh's 5v5 chance share is 4 points worse with him on. Evolving-Hockey had him facing the other team's best last season (97th percentile). Our range for his season is 49 to 74 points.
